label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today in Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on the biggest stories across golf today.

items.headline: CJ CUP Byron Nelson
items.text: Si Woo Kim won the CJ CUP Byron Nelson at 18-under par, finishing five strokes ahead of a six-way tie for second at 13-under including Sungjae Im and Scottie Scheffler.

items.headline: Im’s Hole-in-One Highlights
items.text: Sungjae Im aced the par-3 7th hole and eagled the 9th to finish the second round at 13-under, sharing the lead with Kensei Hirata at the CJ CUP Byron Nelson.

items.headline: Koepka One Back
items.text: Brooks Koepka stands one shot behind at the CJ CUP Byron Nelson, with Scottie Scheffler unable to repeat his wire-to-wire hometown victory.

items.headline: Caddie Takes Blame
items.text: Garrick Higgo's caddie admitted responsibility for a two-stroke PGA penalty that caused Higgo to miss the cut, with Higgo switching caddies at the Byron Nelson.

items.headline: Giant Bunker Debate
items.text: A massive bunker photo posted on r/golf sparked debate over whether it counts as a hazard or waste area, affecting how the ball can be played under golf rules.
